The actual 2026 Oklo PDSA press release makes no mention of Eielson, Alaska, or AI data centers. Dropped on Gate 1 confabulation and Gate 4.

Dropped on Gate 4 (neither press release mentions AI; Alaska AI consequence inferential) and Gate 5 (ANC/NHO designation election chokepoint not established in any primary source).

Cook Inlet LNG FSRU FERC Pre-Filing (facilities): Dropped Gate 4 (ADN June 16 article has zero AI or data center mention). Gate 5 uncertain (multi-member Chugach Electric board offtake decision).
Anchorage CUP / Chugach Electric Capacity Certification (facilities): Gate 1 fail (only in-window trigger is LBB law firm advisory, not independent editorial; AO 2026-27 passed March 27, 91 days before run date). Gate 5 fail (multi-member bodies).
DOE C-MAP Round 2 Alaska AI-Compute Microgrid (vehicles): Gate 1 fail (ACEP/UAF notice May 28 is one day outside the 28-day broadening window).
Alaska BEAD Subgrantee Pipeline NTIA/NIST/ABO Triple-Gate (vehicles): Gate 1 fail (NIST approval March 24, 94 days before run date).
Mapper recommendation for next cycle: DOE Loan Programs Office Alaska project decisions; FAA NextGen Alaska aviation AI; USDA ReConnect Round 5 Alaska awards; NTIA Digital Equity Act Alaska allocations; new SAM.gov Alaska AI solicitations.
